title: Existence of an SDP optimizer
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $G$ be a weighted directed graph on $n$ vertices whose weights are nonnegative and symmetric, sum to $1$ over all ordered pairs of vertices, and vanish on the diagonal. Then there is an assignment of unit vectors in $ br^n$ to the vertices whose SDP value equals the supremum of the SDP values of all such unit-vector assignments.
hypotheses_covered: The sum of all ordered-pair weights is $1$
